Share diagnostics when host enables it
Diagnostics shared only during diagnostics-enabled rides
Opted out: no diagnostics will be collected or shared

What is collected:
• Network stats: RTT latency, packet loss (%), jitter, bitrates.
• Connection events: reconnects, health changes, mute state.
• Rider handles: handles in active ride (no contacts or tokens).
• Device health: battery level, thermal state, network type.
• Location: optional (default OFF).

Where it goes:
Uploaded over HTTPS to the developer diagnostics backend and emailed as an encrypted archive to aid debugging call drops.

Retention: All runs and batches are automatically purged after 30 days.
